title: Structured compile errors instead of strings located by message prefix
description:
The compiler returns `Result<Timeline, Vec<String>>` (`crates/apricity-score/src/compile.rs:494-512`) and there are about 60 non-test `Result<_, String>` signatures in the workspace. `SourceMap::locate` (`dsl.rs:43-80`) recovers a line number by matching message prefixes such as `tracks[`, `clips.` and `progression[` out of the error text. Rewording a message silently loses its location, and YAML scores get no location at all (`compile.rs:505`).

Done when: a `CompileError { path, message, kind, span }` type carries the location from the parser through the compiler; the web editor and the CLI consume it; YAML scores report locations; a test asserts that every error kind reaching the editor has a location.
